findings.suggested_fix: For an accepted valid segment count, filter optionalEmpty to positions below that count and clamp the selected index into range in the same change callback. Preserve temporary invalid numeric input as draft state if needed. Add a browser regression that checks segment 4 as optional, reduces count to 3 and successfully previews/saves a three-segment source without re-expanding the count.
findings.title: Keep obsolete optional split positions editable after reducing the count
findings.why_it_matters: Configure a four-segment split selecting segment 1, mark segment 4 optional, then change the expected count to 3. The change retains optionalEmpty:[3], but the optional-position checkboxes now render only positions 1–3. validateWorkflowConfiguration rejects the hidden position as split-index, so a source containing three valid segments cannot preview, download or save even though every visible setting is valid. The user must discover that temporarily restoring count 4 exposes the stale checkbox. This affects ordinary editing of an existing split rule.
